event CertificateMinted(uint256 indexed tokenId, string indexed lotId, address indexed recycler, string materialCategory, uint256 actualWeightGrams, bytes32 scaleProofHash)
event CertificateRedeemed(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed auditor)

function mintCertificate(string calldata lotId, string calldata handoverId, string calldata materialCategory, uint256 actualWeightGrams, bytes32 collectorIdentityHash, address recyclerAddress, bytes32 scaleProofHash, string calldata ipfsMetadataUri) external returns (uint256)

function getCertificate(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 tokenId, string lotId, string handoverId, string materialCategory, uint256 actualWeightGrams, bytes32 collectorIdentityHash, address recyclerAddress, bytes32 scaleProofHash, uint256 issuedAt, bool isRedeemed, string ipfsMetadataUri))

function getCertificateByLotId(string calldata lotId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 tokenId, string lotId, string handoverId, string materialCategory, uint256 actualWeightGrams, bytes32 collectorIdentityHash, address recyclerAddress, bytes32 scaleProofHash, uint256 issuedAt, bool isRedeemed, string ipfsMetadataUri))
